verdict.rationale: Spline documents a Code API that lets your own code trigger actions and change object properties in exported scenes [spline-docs-6, spline-docs-17]. Webhooks let external events drive scene behaviour [spline-docs-10, spline-docs-26]. A bundled, desktop-only MCP server lets AI clients drive the open editor [spline-docs-25, spline-docs-36]. However, there is no evidence of a general public REST API for driving the product itself (files, editing, publishing), and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path tried [spline-probe-3]. Missing for 10: a documented public API for editor and account operations, an OpenAPI or reference spec, browser-based programmatic access to the editor, and independent hands-on corroboration.
